evaluations.title: Reusable filesystem and HTTP test doubles
evaluations.beneficiary: DevEnv developer writing client and server tests
evaluations.intendedOutcome: Client and server tests reuse shared, runtime-neutral filesystem and HTTP test doubles instead of repeating ad hoc mocks, without real filesystem writes or network I/O.
evaluations.successCondition: Reusable filesystem and HTTP doubles exist, are usable from both client and server Jest suites, have their own tests at 100% coverage, and are adopted by at least one existing client test and one existing server test that previously used ad hoc mocks.
evaluations.baseline: On 2026-10-10 no shared test-double modules existed (no *mock*/*fake*/*stub*/*double* files under projects). HTTP: 19 client spec files use Angular HttpTestingController and 14 server spec files match HTTP-test patterns (HttpTestingController, fetch, supertest or request(app)). Filesystem: 13 server spec files define ad hoc fs mocks (jest.fn readFileSync/writeFileSync/existsSync/readdirSync/mkdirSync or jest.mock of fs). Four separate filesystem boundary interfaces exist: WorkflowTodoExportFileSystem, WorkPlanExportFileSystem, GlossaryExportFileSystem and DevEnvCloneFileSystem. Counts come from repository text searches and may include non-double matches.

measures.value: Outcome, beneficiary and success condition recorded before implementation.
